verdict.rationale: Pylon documents a public developer API for programmatically accessing and acting on its data, including creating issues. The changelog shows new endpoints such as GET /task-statuses, and the bring-your-own-agent docs explicitly point agents at the API to drive ticketing workflows. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), evidence of endpoint reference depth and authentication details, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Pylon's API can be used to programmatically access and take action on data within Pylon.
Added a GET /task-statuses API endpoint for enumerating configured task statuses
Using a combination of Webhooks, API, and/or Pylon MCP, you can connect your agent to ticketing workflows in Pylon.
